title: Hub
description: GET /v1/hub (E18). A client stops syncing when hub_id differs from the one it paired with, takes epoch as its base epoch on its first GET /v1/hub and changes it only when it handles 409 epoch_changed (D24), and refuses to talk to a Hub whose min_contract_version is above its own contract version. Open.

hub_id.description: Fixed for the life of the Hub's data.

epoch.description: A new UUIDv4 on every restore or migration, so restoring the same backup twice still gives different epochs.

contract_version.description: The contract version the Hub speaks.

min_contract_version.description: The oldest client contract version the Hub still accepts.
